derived.crop_box_convention: Left and top inclusive, right and bottom exclusive.
derived.transformation_note: Crop empty upper sky and lower scenery, resize without material aspect distortion, and add transparent side padding. No generated scenery, paint, object replacement, or watermark removal. Transparent padding is necessary because the complete ship is too tall for a direct 1920 by 720 crop.

visual_verification.ship_details: White segmented balloon, wooden hull and deck, left propellers, bottom mechanisms, and forward projecting beam remain intact.
visual_verification.authenticity_basis: The official Create Aeronautics gallery explicitly describes this image as an airship flying near a cliff. It is not a generic Minecraft airship inferred from appearance.
visual_verification.scope_warning: Promotional project screenshot only. Not captured from this Astropunk instance, and not verified against any selected installed release.
